evidence.title: GPT-5.6 is now the preferred model in Microsoft 365 Copilot

summary: Microsoft has updated its 365 Copilot service to use GPT-5.6 as the default AI model, enhancing productivity features for enterprise users. The shift reflects ongoing advancements in AI integration within Microsoft's ecosystem.
title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Now Defaults to GPT-5.6 as Preferred AI Model
